rv.q: Open Air artistic director Timothy Sheader has staged a joyous revival of this old-fashioned, delightful show.

Announcing the West End transfer, the producers Joey Parnes, Sally Horchow and Michael Harrison said: “Susan Stroman’s exuberant production of Crazy For You was the most infectiously joyful show of the year. Charlie and Carly’s performances brought both great romance and spectacle to its heart, and Tom Edden was absolutely hilarious!
